title: Power series in generators of I map onto the I-adic completion
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $f_1,\ldots,f_n\in R$ ($n\geq0$), $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_n)$, and $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_mR/I^m$ the $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For $F=\sum_Ea_Ex^E\in R[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] and $m\geq1$ put $F_{<m}(f)=\sum_{|E|<m}a_Ef^E\in R$ (with $f^E=f_1^{e_1}\cdots f_n^{e_n}$, $|E|=e_1+\cdots+e_n$). Then $\Phi(F)=(F_{<m}(f)\bmod I^m)_{m\geq1}$ is an element of $R^\wedge$, and $\Phi:R[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]\to R^\wedge$ is a surjective ring homomorphism with $\Phi(x_i)=(f_i\bmod I^m)_m$ and $\Phi(r)=(r\bmod I^m)_m$ for $r\in R$.
